semantics.asn_index: Country entries summarize registration claims of member allocations. Network types summarize scoped observations of member networks, not a classification of the entire ASN.
semantics.connection_type: Explicit access classification only; absent when unknown. Overlay tunnels do not identify subscriber access technology.
semantics.irr_status: Registry route-object match for irr_prefix. Host overlays retain the original validation prefix.
semantics.location: Operator-authorized GeoFeed claim, else the origin country from DN42 BGP communities or ICMP latency, named by confidence; registry registration country is separate. City coordinates come from GeoNames.
semantics.network_types: Published service roles or observed BGP path characteristics; method and source describe the evidence.
semantics.ptr: Reverse DNS observations apply only to their queried host address.
semantics.roa_status: Registry-derived DN42 origin policy for roa_prefix; method and origin ASN are attached to each observation. No cryptographic RPKI validation is implied.
